description: Catalogue a pcap or pcapng: capinfos metadata and a complete listing of the selected fields of every packet and of the DNS, HTTP and TLS packets (and of HTTP/2 and QUIC packets when the installed tshark lists their fields), for examiner pivots. A receipt from the first moment records each step, the tool versions and the truncated packets; the listings are one tshark's reading, not the capture.
exclusions: protocols other than DNS, HTTP, TLS, and HTTP/2 and QUIC where the installed tshark lists their fields, are listed per packet, not decoded field by field
payloads and transferred objects are not reassembled or carved
fields of packets that were truncated, malformed or of a protocol tshark does not decode
http2.tsv and quic.tsv are not made when the installed tshark does not list the fields they need (the receipt says so)
covers: Capture metadata and, for every packet, the selected fields tshark can decode (packets.tsv), with DNS, HTTP and TLS listings and, only where the installed tshark lists their fields, HTTP/2 and QUIC. It does not assert that a missing protocol is absent when packets were truncated, encrypted, malformed or unsupported; coverage.json counts the truncated packets. http.tsv can hold credentials in request URIs and is marked secret-bearing in the receipt.
